source_app: Command Desk (Sam's own product) — Interview v3 answers, 5 September 2026

answers.A.01: A desk where one agent runs other agents. The builder-tester loop runs as a script. An email agent is attached to Sam's real email. Hands and the Brain pipeline are specialists on the desk.
answers.A.02: One front agent (Nova) that Sam talks to, which dispatches to the specialists, so Sam has minimal direct contact with them and it keeps on top of everything in flight.
answers.A.04: Sam tells Nova a job and finds the real result waiting — an actual draft in his inbox, the Brain pipeline actually gathered and configured. Verified by outcome, not by a report.
answers.C.01: Minimal. Centre orb is the yin-yang, sized like the ChatGPT voice orb, spoken to; the outer gold ring spins while Nova works, the inner glyph stays still. The whole interface slides across to reveal a full-panel left menu, not an overlay. Home carries only the composer at the bottom, time top-left, settings top-right.

C.04.path: orb-glyph.png + orb-rotor.png (gold; Sam's own mark, cut from the reference screenshot)

per_instance.RP.05:Activity per agent:jobs done per a: a job counts once, in the ISO week its Finished at falls in, against the agent named on the job, when its stage is done
per_instance.RP.05:Activity per agent:jobs failed per: a job counts once, in the ISO week its Finished at falls in, against the agent named on the job, when its stage is failed; a job that was retried and then finished counts as done in the week it finished and no longer counts as a failure

features.rule: every model provider is a Linked service; removing the hosted ones leaves Ollama only
drop 'email' from the channels and the yin-yang badge is the only notice
every extra action is a button AND a voice command; dropping voice leaves the buttons
